title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
original_title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
plot_overview: After a legendary Rose Bowl performance, a celebrated college football star enters the NFL with enormous expectations. Injuries, conflict, and sudden loss complicate his career, revealing a more difficult journey than the highlight reels suggest.
will_you_like_this: You’ll like this if you enjoy candid sports documentaries and personal career stories such as The Playbook; Not for you if you prefer lighter, purely celebratory football profiles.
review_summary: Pros: compelling sports story; emotional personal stakes; behind-the-scenes perspective | Cons: potentially heavy subject matter; familiar rise-and-fall arc
